Title: Competent Engineer Approval implementation claim is unsupported
Condition: The source status is Implemented, but the applicability register links no stable evidence ID and the reviewed repository contains no population, execution sample, exceptions, metrics or owner review.
Criteria: An Implemented status must be supported by retrievable, version-bound implementation and operating evidence.
Cause: Evidence was not linked or supplied; the cause of the evidence gap requires management confirmation.
Effect: The control cannot receive implementation, effectiveness or risk-reduction credit; reliance could overstate assurance.
Required_Action: Provide and independently validate the requested evidence or change the operational status to Not demonstrated/Planned; reassess related risk treatment.
Closure_Evidence: Validated evidence package or approved status downgrade, risk reassessment and crosswalk update
